fusions.name: Spore Tangle
fusions.desc: Looses a cone of spores along a taut line that deals 10 damage to everything within 4 tiles and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Rot Harvest
fusions.desc: Strikes an enemy at or below 30% health for 20 damage, using up every affliction on it to add 1.5 times their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Spore Lattice
fusions.desc: Raises a growth where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Rooting Thread
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
